reviewer: Kimi actually viewed the exact 65x67 original, independent 528x720 source-note derivative, complete unchanged external-05 raw PNG, native note crops at x=1100,y=1000,width=700,height=300 and x=1150,y=1060,width=500,height=170, and full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet. The previous uniform three-plus-four dashes are replaced by two compact irregular groups in each row with distinct left/right spacing and relative lengths. The bald crown, side/back hair, brows, suit, shirt collar, tie, frame/backplate and right-edge tab remain. Evidence-page source/output/task/prompt/request/result bindings and the 249-result record verification were checked; this is an experimental approval pending formal import, not production or game acceptance.

hair_features.reason: The bald crown, short gray-brown side/back hair and sideburns, dark brows and clean-shaven chin are preserved without adding crown hair, a beard or glasses.

collar_fit.reason: The white pointed shirt collar and dark tie meet the rounded chin through a short broad fitted transition, without a neck stalk, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot keeps the nearly frontal serious face, bald crown with side/back hair, dark brows, dark suit, white shirt and dark patterned tie. Both note rows contain TWO separated source-scale irregular gray-mark groups with compact relative lengths and spacing, rather than three upper and four lower uniform dashes. The lower paper remains blank outside those groups and the small right-edge tab and complete photographic frame/backplate remain.
entries.alpha_decision: The native RGBA is 2048x2048 with extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=1615537, 252=1378814, 253=1062293, 254=296 and 255=0. Complete white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparisons show genuine exterior transparency around the complete card/frame/note silhouette without visible interior holes, lost backing or a working-matte halo. Internal 252-254 values alone are not rejection grounds.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine tie motifs, individual note glyph identities and tiny frame texture cannot be resolved at 65x67. Approval is for clearly visible group count, irregular shapes, relative lengths, clothing, hair, collar and alpha, not guessed writing.
